newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Rugby union-Smith gives New South Wales players a boost.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-Smith gives New South Wales players a boost.

text.p: Australia rugby union coach Greg Smith has told New South Wales players they remain in his test plans this season despite the Waratahs' recent form slump.
Smith delivered his message at a training session ahead of the vital Super 12 match against Wellington in New Zealand on Friday.
New South Wales have crashed to heavy defeats against Queensland and ACT Brumbies in recent weeks, prompting suggestions only fullback Matthew Burke can look forward to a test berth this season.
Smith dismissed such reports as groundless speculation and a lot of rubbish.

"I saw the New South Wales scrum perform better three weeks ago than any scrum in Australia. Can you forget that after two losses? No, I don't think so," Smith said, referring to the home win against Free State.
Mid-table New South Wales must win their last three matches to have any chance of qualifying for the Super 12 semifinals in late May.
Smith will take charge of the Wallabies for a two-test series against Five Nations champions France in June.
